note: Adapted from the 27th species entry (pp. 117–122) of Roonwal & Maiti (1966), 'Termites from Indonesia including West Irian' (Treubia 27(1): 63–140), originally in English; it is the original description (n. sp.), with the alate described from a single dealate queen with a damaged abdomen, together with the soldier and large and small worker types. The original measurement tables (Tables 6–8), figure numbers, material lists, geographical distribution and Remarks have not been entered item by item; the measurements are taken from the text and the tables. Suspected OCR errors (such as '0.06', probably 0.96, and '1.00 — 8.5') have been read according to the tables, and where the reading could not be determined nothing was entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate (from a single dealate queen): head capsule chestnut brown, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown; head nearly square, maximum width including the compound eyes 1.23 mm, length to the lateral mandibular base 1.22 mm; ocelli elongate-oval, prominent, length 0.23 mm; frontal gland plate prominent, length 0.22 mm; pronotum almost crescent-shaped, width 1.06 mm, length 0.70 mm, anterior margin almost straight, without a median notch. Soldier: head capsule (excluding the rostrum) nearly pear-shaped, length 0.90—0.94 mm, maximum width 0.75—0.80 mm, rostrum length 0.47—0.50 mm, body length about 3.5—3.8 mm; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, width 0.40—0.45 mm, length 0.16—0.20 mm. Workers in large and small types, with antennae of 14 and 13 segments respectively.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The following description is based on a single dealate queen with a damaged abdomen. Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae and pronotum yellowish brown; legs pale yellow. Head and body sparsely hairy. Head capsule nearly square, slightly flattened; length and width almost equal (maximum width including the compound eyes 1.23 mm, length to the lateral mandibular base 1.22 mm); posterior margin rounded; sides weakly convex. Compound eyes large, nearly circular, close to the antennae (minimum eye—antenna distance 0.05 mm); ocular plate rather broad. Ocelli elongate-oval, prominent (length 0.23 mm), almost touching the compound eyes (minimum eye—ocellus distance 0.04 mm). Frontal gland plate prominent, rather large, white, slightly elongate (length 0.22 mm), situated in the middle of the head capsule, with a distinct suture behind the plate. Antennae broken, only the basal 11 segments preserved; segment 1 thick, cylindrical and longest, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 smallest, segments 5 and 6 nearly equal in length, segments 7—11 nearly oval and gradually longer. Anteclypeus transparent, slightly wider than long; postclypeus far wider than long, with a median groove and several setae. Labrum white, rounded, wider than long (maximum width 0.46 mm, maximum length 0.33 mm), the sides convex, the apical margin rounded. Mandibles of the typical Bulbitermes type: the left with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly obtuse and smaller than the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth long, close to the apical tooth and with a long concave posterior edge, the 2nd marginal tooth small and obtuse; the right also with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth sharper and smaller than the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth distinct with its two sides almost equal in length, the 2nd marginal tooth obtuse and small, close to the 1st marginal tooth. Pronotum flat, almost crescent-shaped, far wider than long (maximum width 1.06 mm, maximum length 0.70 mm); anterolateral corners narrowly rounded and with long setae; lateral margins weakly convex, narrowing posteriorly; anterior margin almost straight, without a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, slightly incurved in the middle. Legs short, sparsely hairy; hind femur slender (length 1.38 mm, width 0.23 mm); apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Abdomen damaged. Body length without wings about 12.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown to dark brown; rostrum brown, darker in the middle and paler at the apex; antennae yellowish brown, paler towards the apex; thoracic nota, femora and anterior abdominal tergites brown, the posterior tergites yellowish brown. Pilosity very sparse, only a few posterior tergites with a few small setae. Body length about 3.5—3.8 mm. Head capsule (excluding the rostrum) nearly pear-shaped, slightly constricted behind the antennal bases; slightly longer than wide (head length without the rostrum 0.90—0.94 mm, maximum width 0.75—0.80 mm); widest posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded; dorsal outline without a median depression; posterior elevation 0.30—0.34 mm; vertex with 1 pair of setae, otherwise bare. Rostrum short, almost subconical, its length about equal to half the length of the head capsule (excluding the rostrum) (0.47—0.50 mm); no distinct rostral hump; apex with several setae. Frontal gland and frontal gland duct distinct. Antennae 12—13-segmented, the segments rather densely hairy; segment 1 long, cylindrical and thick; segment 2 smallest; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 nearly equal in length to segment 3 (much shorter than segment 3 in the 13-segmented antenna); segment 5 nearly equal in length to segment 4; from segment 6 to the last gradually longer. Labrum small, wider than long; anterior margin slightly depressed; anterolateral corners rounded. Anteclypeus white, far wider than long, the anterior margin weakly convex; postclypeus distinct, the anterior margin convex, the boundary with the posterior part not sharp. Mandibles reduced, small; each with one short, pointed, toothed or toothless spinous lateral process, the process far shorter than the outer edge of the molar region; usually with 1 conspicuous accessory tooth at its base, on the left mandible, the right mandible or both; the edge of the molar plate irregular. Postmentum wider than long (median length 0.23—0.27 mm, maximum width 0.26—0.30 mm); widest in the middle; anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin concave. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, more than 2 times as wide as long (maximum length 0.16—0.20 mm, width 0.40—0.45 mm); anterior margin with a weak median notch; posterior margin convex. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum convex, without a median notch. Legs: femora, tibiae and tarsi rather slender; femora with many short hairs, the tibiae more densely hairy; hind femur longer than the tibia and not reaching the end of the abdomen; tarsi 4-segmented, densely hairy; apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Abdomen: all tergites except the last 3—4 without long hairs, the sternites with many long hairs; cerci short, 2-segmented, hairy; styli absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head brown; thorax light brown; antennae and femora yellowish brown; tergites, tibiae and tarsi paler. Dorsal pilosity sparse, ventral dense. Head capsule nearly square, about as long as wide; Y-shaped suture distinct; the frontal gland lies in the middle of the junction of the two frontal sutures and is covered by a small whitish, nearly oval plate. Antennae 14-segmented, the segments rather densely hairy; segment 1 longest, thick, cylindrical; segments 2 and 3 nearly equal in length and slightly longer than segment 4; segments 5—14 gradually longer. Anteclypeus white, the anterior margin distinctly convex; postclypeus also distinct, raised, light brown, far wider than long, with an indistinct median groove. Labrum far wider than long; anterior and lateral margins convex; a few setae in the middle. Mandibles stout, yellowish brown, the toothed edge dark brown; left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth distinct with a broad base and slightly shorter than the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth well developed with its posterior edge far longer than its anterior, the 2nd marginal tooth small and far from the 1st; right mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth sharp, conical and nearly equal to the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth close to the apical tooth and stout, the 2nd marginal tooth small, obtuse and with a long posterior edge; molar plate stout and prominent. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, with microtrichia, its width nearly half the head width. Measurements: large worker head length (to the lateral mandibular base) 0.98—1.00 mm, maximum width 1.00—1.09 mm, labrum 0.24—0.31 × 0.35—0.42 mm, pronotum 0.25—0.30 × 0.48—0.56 mm, antennae 14-segmented; small worker head length 0.73—0.80 mm, maximum width 0.82—0.90 mm, pronotum 0.14—0.21 × 0.39—0.45 mm, antennae 13-segmented.
